title: Complete companion owner: every family, micro detail, reveal card and later correction
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full companion palette reviewed; dated engine/clock statements and proposed constraints reconciled against current direction
reviews.disposition:
All1650 pre-fold lines were read in eleven contiguous150-line ranges. This promotes the earlier selected-owner maintenance to full actual-content coverage, including every A–N family, O–Z/AA–IC addition, J1–J62 card, C1–C16 return/correction, DSC1–DSC5 and later B7/B67/B79 folds. Linked source/dispatch bodies are not newly credited as read. This is a retained design palette, not a current inventory of implemented companions. Its opening “nothing selected”, “still running”, “no companion page” and Rill/reset/storage/clock descriptions belong to their dated Oct14 passes. They do not override later deliveries, current code or the current PROJECT queue.

Kinds and relations remain distinct. A1–A15/B1–B12 describe pets, working animals, mounts, spirits/contracts, made/undead/object/system beings, swarms, plants, places and young creatures with different acquisition and actual carriers. C1–C13/O/P/CA keep trust, affection, obedience, understanding, contract terms, shared channels, respect, independent goals and communication separate. A sapient ally's decisions, material ownership and local legal status are different facts; calling it property or a person in one world's law does not settle its actual agency or every contract. Care and shared history can matter without a paid work benefit. R113, EA, FJ and BH retain ordinary presence, sitting together and unowned wild relationships as complete useful play. HC3's “not time or gifts” is an overstatement if applied universally: real time together and real gifts may causally affect bonds through actual experience and the particular recipient. Neither automatically buys obedience or a completed relationship. No mandatory bond grind, wages, quota or relationship meter is inferred.

D–G, I, Q, R, AE–AF, BE/BF, CJ/CK and IA keep body/age, loss, memories, continuity, support, custody and clocks separate. A new holder or inherited name is not the same person/animal; inherited property does not silently transfer another being's agreement. Shared senses, borrowed faculty, possession, fusion, multiple bodies, mind and original/source memory need their actual link/consumer, with explicit merge/return boundaries. Missing or silent is not dead. Revival, grief and legacy need not impose a compulsory lasting wound. No single care, legal permission, carrying or release rule applies to all animals/spirits/tools/persons. The old one-prestige milestone in Round5 is retired by later Oct24 direction. C13's L00–L07 is a proposed dependency sketch, not a mandatory preliminary engine program or fresh companion build schedule; AD51 favors the first useful shared seam with local differences and validation by another use.

E/U/V/DA–EZ/FA–FO/GD/HG/IB preserve the detailed routines, preferences, habits, firsts/lasts, ordinary care, social texture and recoverable small mistakes. No specific cue universally diagnoses happiness, illness, guilt, weather, motive or hidden truth. C9's later context/species caveats qualify earlier body-language and illness examples; no veterinary/ethology claim is freshly verified here. “Show, do not meter”, FA1's “never a verdict” and HC2 are taste defaults, not bans on accurate own-native stats under AD8 or actual acquired appraisal. Other observers learn through actual sensory/knowledge routes. A familiar's viewpoint, narrator thought bubble, retained memory, live reading and forecast have different reach and reliability. GA1–GA7/RF0–RF6 describe kinds of information, not a compulsory linear unlock tree or an enforced error/cost tax on powerful means. J1–J62's sample twists are alternatives, not mandatory drawbacks, clue trails or counters; exact, strong, quiet powers can work by their mechanisms. Neither closeness nor a label supplies omniscience, but an effective means need not be weakened merely for balance.

GC3/HD7 are already corrected by C13 F3: transient state captions can be pure, emitted history needs replay/deduplication identity. C9's3–5-minute cadence and C10'ssix/hour/eight-minute spacing are competing taste proposals, not measured performance or universal caps. A remembered sighting does not refresh when current truth changes; accessible text and UI must keep the same observer scope. HD's proposed eight shapes versus C16'sseven keep Thread with the story owner, without requiring a pet-only store or converting all beings into one actor/consent shape. Generated resolved traits need stable identity; HG4's absolute that two saves never share a personality is not a necessary uniqueness guarantee. A seed alone must not silently reroll settled outputs on reload, and different seeds are not proof every personality differs.

C8/GC6/HC7's closed-browser-rest and capped-work recommendations are dated proposals. Current AD16/OD4 permits chosen current-world routines with actual time, supply and important-choice stops, while inactive worlds pause by default; offline aging is world/settings dependent. TBANK's exact limits/rates remain open. Neither universal away rest nor automatic paid labor, household care, death, hunger loss or new pet-specific cap follows. AD52 can compress repeated care, travel, training and work while preserving consequential choices, actual participants/results, knowledge and clocks; convenience is not a short campaign limit. Late C6/C11 G1–G3 procedures remain valuable proposed treatment of contagion, conflicting carers and becoming sapient, with selection/execution still separate. Keep necessary support, actual exposure versus illness, reviewed permissions and past care/history distinct.

H/HA and C1/C7/C14 retain their stated source levels and corrections, including HP pets versus a generic familiar rule, Jujutsu technique distinctions, messenger-bird exceptions, uncertain Skyrim ghost dog and comic source-era/mantle/counterpart differences. Source labels, saved captures or “checked” summaries are not current chapter/variant qualification by this review. BB/BC/HE/HF/DSC preserve useful making for/with/from creatures, actor creation, provenance, harmless versus nonlethal versus consent/legal approval, paid specialist work and knowledge research without activating all adjacent economies. A portrait/roster/knowledge card is not a placed traveling worker, an inherited gun or a paid service. Use actual current owners and current PROJECT sequencing before selecting a case. No animal, actor, cue scheduler, reveal, companion UI, persistence migration, source-world behavior or current runtime absence is implemented or demonstrated by this documentation pass.
reviews.evidence: All1650 current lines read in eleven150-line chunks, no truncation. Selected current AD8/AD16/AD33/AD42/AD51/AD52 and OD4/TBANK rows inspected; no linked source/body/runtime artifacts re-exercised.
reviews.reopen: For a selected companion slice inspect current actor/body/custody/knowledge/clock and actual command/result owners; retain source- and variant-specific gaps rather than rebuilding the whole palette.
